drivingQuestion: Why must the mishna state that the cloth reduces exam-to-exam?
outcomeNote: Question completes and is answered in the next unit

segments.he: מְמַעֶטֶת עַל יָד מֵעֵת לְעֵת, הַשְׁתָּא מֵעֵת לְעֵת מְמַעֶטֶת,
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: And with regard to a woman who engages in intercourse while using examination cloths, as the halakhic status of that act is like that of an examination, «it reduces» the time «from» a twenty-four-hour «period,» and reduces the time from examination to examination. The Gemara asks: «Now» that the mishna teaches that this examination «reduces» time «from» a twenty-four-hour «period,»
